name: U.S.Z.I.O.K.
source: Sometimes, you may wonder what your life would look like if you had made a different decision at some point in time. That's what Zenon - the main character - does every day. He's forced to receive treatment inside a weird machine called N.E.M.O., which is supposed to be helping him recover from his partial amnesia. The space complex, however, doesn't really seem to be what it pretends to be. While Zenon is growing more and more suspicious of the events happening around him, the other part of the story takes place in his memories, where he's reliving his high school life.
translation: 有时，你会想知道，如果自己在人生的某个时刻做出了不同的决定，生活会变成什么样。主角泽农每天都会这样想。他被迫在一台名为N.E.M.O.的奇怪机器中接受治疗，据说这能帮助他恢复部分失忆。然而，这座太空设施似乎并不像表面上那样单纯。泽农对身边发生的一切越来越怀疑，而故事的另一部分则发生在他的记忆中，在那里，他重新经历着高中生活。
